rites.name: Nuamuala
rites.text: Nuamuala is a rite of the Courts of Vesizora in which the council binds a dying star into a gate between worlds, its light folding inward as the doors take shape. The act is remembered as the first time the Courts agreed to share one passage across all their realms.

rites.name: Osyusora
rites.text: Osyusora is a concept of Vesizora, a force of tidal memory that the Courts set against drowned oaths during the Age of Sundering. It was invoked to hold the doors between worlds shut while landfall broke old bonds.
